the_five_instruments_indicted: 1. THE ESCAPED-JSON BLINDNESS (the big one): agent-browser eval returns escaped JSON — "{\"cards\":1,…}" — and every readiness grep in every ride script since t1174 matched literal '"cards":1', which NEVER matches the escaped form. The 23:12 round's canvas was READY (cards:1) and the script declared CANVAS_NOT_READY. Fixed with tr -d '\\' before grep in scripts/t1175-whale-quiet-compile.sh (4 sites). The t1174 ride's 'zero cards' verdicts were partly this.

2. THE PARTIAL-HARVEST BLINDNESS: the reaper's harvest is PARTIAL — it emptied node_modules to exactly ONE entry ('next', the entry point itself, so the server STARTS and dies on its first require with MODULE_NOT_FOUND requireStack:[]) while the directory survived. Every guard was '[ ! -d node_modules ]' — exists-checks never fire on a partial harvest. Fixed to COUNT guards ('< 600 of the known 643') in scripts/dev-server.sh (the launcher, both boot paths), scripts/t1174-cure-ride.sh, scripts/t1175-cure-walk.sh, scripts/t1175-whale-quiet-compile.sh.

3. THE ZOMBIE-TAB ORDER VIOLATION: about:blank must precede ALL server contact; the 22:04 boot fed a stale tab's HMR reconnect a full reload fan-out (GET / 200 in 431ms then a compile-storm burst that made the ride's own lane checks time out at 000). scripts/t1174-cure-ride.sh patched: the neuter moved above the lane check.

4. THE DEAD-PAGE BLINDNESS: a Chrome 'This site can't be reached' error page keeps location.href = http://localhost:3000/ — the re-dress detector grepping href for 'chrome-error' NEVER fired; dead pages read as card-less loading pages. Fixed: the detector now reads body text ('refused to connect').

5. THE OVER-FARM: grepping every /api/ path out of client chunks and curling all ~20 routes chrome-less re-inflated the server past the box — the farm's own curls OOM'd the server mid-farm (pre-load then hit 000 × 8). Trimmed to the surgical 8-route boot-fan-out pre-load (jobs/projects/workspaces/views/edges/remote/connections/relion-status/ai/settings — 6×200, 2×404 wrong-path, harmless).

the_cure_method_that_worked.name: the quiet compile (chrome-less whale + chunk farm + require-cache pre-load)
the_cure_method_that_worked.steps: chrome dies (~862MB freed) → server boots (webpack lane, 1792 heap) → curl GET / compiles the canvas whale for a browser that never arrives (200 in 29s cold, 0s warm-persisted) → farm the HTML-referenced chunks (10+1) chrome-less → pre-load the 8 boot API routes into the require cache (a loaded module survives the harvest's unlink) → chrome returns → cards in ~12s
the_cure_method_that_worked.measured: canvas ready ~12s after navigation on the best round; GET / 200 in 0s once persisted

the_oom_anatomy: every server death tonight was the kernel OOM killer (dmesg: next-server corpses at anon-rss 2.27–3.20GB, 6+ kills witnessed) — NOT a platform process reaper; the structural deficit: dev server (canvas graph + API route graphs, 2.5–2.8GB) + chrome (862MB) + system (~1GB) > 4GB box. The successful rounds were the coin flips that landed. drop_caches denied (read-only /proc, no root).

judge_lines: 「仪器会瞎，世界不会」: the canvas rendered twice while the instruments read zero — an escaped-JSON grep blind from birth outlived four honest rides; calibrate the instrument before re-indicting the world.
「清道夫连收割都是部分的」: one surviving entry ('next') was enough to make the tree look alive and die on first require — a guard that asks 'does it exist' is not a guard; ask 'how much of it exists'.
「给不来的浏览器编译」: the whale that kills every visitor fits the box alone — chrome-less curl compiled and persisted in 29s what no ride could survive; the visitor then lands on a 0s serve.
next_window_hooks: t1176: the walk stands armed — calm box (available ≥ 3GB at window open) → bash scripts/t1175-whale-quiet-compile.sh (one call, ~5 min) reads the Escape verdict; if the box is squeezed, the verdict stays UNPROVEN and the instrument waits; the build day needs a bigger calmer box than tonight's 3.26GB; the census resumes when the lane holds two calls
